metadata.name: [SRE] OpenSearch used-space % > 85
metadata.description: P2 OpenSearch used-space % > 85 for 15m (USW Splunk formula). P1 sibling fires at 90.

breach.query:
FROM metrics-aws.cloudwatch_metrics-*
| WHERE @timestamp >= ?_tstart AND @timestamp < ?_tend
| WHERE aws.cloudwatch.namespace == "AWS/ES" AND aws.dimensions.NodeId IS NULL
| STATS used = MAX(aws.es.metrics.ClusterUsedSpace.max),
        free = AVG(aws.es.metrics.FreeStorageSpace.avg)
    BY aws.dimensions.DomainName, cloud.account.id, cloud.region
| EVAL pct = used / (used + free) * 100
| WHERE pct > 85
| KEEP aws.dimensions.DomainName, cloud.account.id, cloud.region, used, free, pct
